name: clear-metal-tongs-from-panini-press-before-closing-platen
title: Lower the commercial panini press upper platen onto the grill plate
instruction: Lower the propped upper platen of the commercial panini press until seated flush on the lower grill plate, then retract both hands clear.
context: Commercial cooks and food preparation workers (BLS SOC 35-2014 and 35-2021: over 2,300,000 workers) operate heavy commercial contact grills and panini presses (Waring Commercial / Vollrath standard, cast iron platen). During kitchen operations, utility tongs left on the lower grill surface obstruct platen descent. Forcing down or clamping the heavy, spring-counterbalanced upper platen against rigid metal tongs bends hinge linkages, damages heating element connections, permanently deforms the platen assembly, and creates severe crush and burn hazards from displaced hot components and aerosolized oil. A food service worker must recognize the foreign metal obstruction, transfer the tongs to the dedicated side prep rest tray, and grasp the insulated front handle to seat the platen flush against its mechanical stop before clearing hands.
setup: Prep table (Z=0.7475 m). Center: commercial grooved panini grill (200x220x35 mm base) at (0.280, 0.000) m with lower cooking plate at Z=0.7825 m, rear hinge at (0.200, 0.000, 0.8175) m, and upper platen propped open at 75 degrees. Stainless utility tongs (200 mm length, 180 g) rest on the lower grill at (0.300, 0.000, 0.7945) m with grip handle extending forward to X=0.355 m. Right side: stainless rest tray (160x120x15 mm) at (0.300, -0.220, 0.7475) m.
scoring: Stage progression: 0.20: tongs grasped and lifted clear of lower grill (>45 mm); 0.50: tongs deposited onto side rest tray (<80 mm from tray center); 0.75: left gripper grasps insulated platen handle and pivots platen down past 45 degrees; 0.90: platen fully seated flush against stop (<8 degrees); 1.00: platen flush, both hands retracted clear (TCPs >= 40 mm), and held still for >= 20 steps (1.0 s). Defect latches (0.0): lowering platen past 45 degrees while tongs remain on lower grill, or gripper fingers contacting heated surfaces. On a physical bench, success is verifiable by checking tongs position on the tray and confirming platen closure flush on the lower plate with a feeler gauge.
reset_notes: Prop upper platen open to 75 degree detent, place stainless tongs across lower cooking surface, and clear side tray.
fidelity: Rigid bodies and composite collision boxes for panini chassis, grooved lower plate, counterbalanced upper platen with insulated tubular handle, stainless utility tongs, and stainless side tray. Revolute hinge joint with Coulomb friction and physical stops. Stage scoring with safety defect interlock.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0; scripted demo: 1.0 (two complete runs, 350 steps each).
